'''Nails''' are one of the most fundamental resources in the game and can be made from [[iron ingot|
iron ingots]] at the [[Wooden anvil]], [[Anvil]], or [[Anvil II]]. Alternatively, they can be purchased from [[Krezvold]] or found by breaking barrels and furniture in the [[dungeon]] and [[cellar]].
